reviewNotes: Twenty-five general-store, Hat Mouse, Traveling Cart, saloon, Adventurer's Guild, and specialty-shop lines were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover character-specific speech, placeholders and fragment boundaries, approved place and regional names, dialogue-action markup, punctuation, and natural shopkeeper voice; both found no remaining objective issue.

ShopMenu.cs.11483.source: What can I get for you?

ShopMenu.cs.11484.source: I carry only the finest goods.
ShopMenu.cs.11484.translation: Am doar mărfuri de cea mai bună calitate.

ShopMenu.cs.11485.source: I've got quality goods for sale.
ShopMenu.cs.11485.translation: Am mărfuri de calitate de vânzare.

ShopMenu.cs.11487.source: Got anything you want to sell?

ShopMenu.cs.11488.translation: Bun venit la magazinul lui Pierre!

ShopMenu.cs.11489.source: The season's almost over. I'll be changing stock tomorrow.
ShopMenu.cs.11489.translation: Anotimpul este aproape de sfârșit. Mâine voi schimba marfa.

ShopMenu.cs.11494.source: Hiyo, poke. Did you bring coins? Gud. Me sell hats.
ShopMenu.cs.11494.translation: Sal'tare, om. Ai monede? Bun. Eu vând pălării.

ShopMenu.cs.11499.source: I've got a little bit of everything. Take a look!
ShopMenu.cs.11499.translation: Am câte puțin din toate. Aruncă o privire!

ShopMenu.cs.11500.source: I smuggled these goods out of the Gotoro Empire. Why do you think they're so expensive?
ShopMenu.cs.11500.translation: Am scos aceste mărfuri pe ascuns din Imperiul Gotoro. De ce crezi că sunt atât de scumpe?

ShopMenu.cs.11501.source: I'll have new items every week, so make sure to come back!
ShopMenu.cs.11501.translation: Voi avea obiecte noi în fiecare săptămână, așa că nu uita să revii!

ShopMenu.cs.11502.source: Let me see... Oh! I've got just what you need: {0}!
ShopMenu.cs.11502.translation: Să vedem... Oh! Am exact ce îți trebuie: {0}!

ShopMenu.cs.11504.source: Beautiful country you have here. One of my favorite stops. The pig likes it, too.
ShopMenu.cs.11504.translation: Aveți o țară frumoasă aici. Este una dintre opririle mele preferate. Și porcului îi place.

ShopMenu.cs.11508.source: *sigh*... When the door opened I thought it might be Lewis.
ShopMenu.cs.11508.translation: *oftează*... Când s-a deschis ușa, am crezut că ar putea fi Lewis.

ShopMenu.cs.11513.source: Hungry? Thirsty? I've got just the thing.
ShopMenu.cs.11513.translation: Ți-e foame? Ți-e sete? Am exact ce trebuie.

ShopMenu.cs.11514.source: Welcome to the Stardrop Saloon! What can I get ya?
ShopMenu.cs.11514.translation: Bun venit la Taverna Picăturii Stelare! Ce pot să-ți ofer?

ShopMenu.cs.11517.source: The caves can be dangerous. Make sure you're prepared.
ShopMenu.cs.11517.translation: Peșterile pot fi periculoase. Ai grijă să te pregătești bine.

ShopMenu.cs.11518.source: In the market for a new sword?

ShopMenu.cs.11520.source: Slay any monsters? I'll buy the loot.
ShopMenu.cs.11520.translation: Ai ucis monștri? Îți cumpăr prada.
